reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin centered on OpenViking semantic retrieval, shared persistent memory, resource management, automatic recall, and session memory commits.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 集成 OpenViking，提供语义检索、资源管理、自动记忆召回与会话记忆沉淀。
summaries.en: Integrates OpenViking with DeepSeek Harness to provide semantic retrieval, resource management, automatic memory recall, and persistent session memory.

capabilities: semantic and exact search of OpenViking resources
adding remote URLs or local text files to the resource store
persisting session memories and learned playbooks
automatic memory recall and session commits
communicating with a configured OpenViking service using optional API credentials
